; Solutions to the Microban levels the Sokoban example ships, one a line: the level's number,
; then its moves in LURD (a letter a step, upper case where it pushes a box). Found by a
; solver written for these tests (breadth-first on pushes; best-first, forwards and pulling
; backwards, for the levels with most boxes), and checked by replaying each in sokoban.rs.
